title: GatePulse — SQL via Fabric Pipeline
description: Run ad hoc SQL from VS Code on any Microsoft Fabric-authorized connection — gateway (on-prem / IP-filtered) or cloud — through a generic Fabric pipeline, driven only by the Fabric REST API.

title: Marvel Heroes Themes
description: 15 calm, lightweight colour themes inspired by Marvel heroes and villains

title: Margin — Markdown Editor
description: Turn the Markdown in your repo into a Notion-style knowledge base: clean pages you edit in place, linked docs, slash commands and AI. Files stay plain Markdown, so git diffs stay small.

title: sr Angular Toolkit
description: Developer toolkit for Angular developers with generators, snippets, project utilities, and productivity features.

title: Recent Workspaces
description: Open Recent, but workspaces only: every .code-workspace you have ever opened in one list, re-checked against the disk — a workspace whose file is gone is shown faded, not hidden. Favorites on top, drag-and-drop order, folder icons in the color Peacock gave the window. No telemetry.

title: Formular-Check: Schriftform & Textform (BEG IV)
description: Prüft deutsche Formular- und Vertragsvorlagen (Markdown, HTML, Text) auf veraltete Form- und Fristangaben nach BEG IV: Kündigung, Nachweisgesetz, Belegaufbewahrung, Mahnbescheid.

title: Fristenkalender Lint: Fristen berechnen
description: Prüft Fristenkalender-CSV gegen §§ 187–193 BGB und § 222 ZPO: Ereignistag, Monatsende, Wochenende und die Feiertage des richtigen Bundeslands. 12 rules, offline.

title: GDPR Privacy Notice Lint
description: Reads the privacy notice in your repo against 16 rules from GDPR Articles 13 and 14, flags template placeholders, and tells you when the notice itself has gone stale. Not legal advice.

title: PingAM Config Promoter
description: Compare self-hosted PingAM (7.x/8.x) environments and promote OAuth2 clients, the OAuth2 provider, realm services, SAML entities and scripts from one to another, with review, backup and rollback.
